newsitem.title: FINLAND: RESEARCH ALERT - GS reinstates Pohjola buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - GS reinstates Pohjola buy.

text.p: Goldman Sachs has reinstated its "buy" recommendation on Finnish insurance group Pohjola and raised its 12-month target price to 182 markka from 142, Goldman Sachs analyst Giovanni Govi told Reuters by telephone on Monday.

"I have reinstated my buy recommendation for Pohjola," Govi said, adding he had updated his recommendation after Pohjola last Thursday announced plans to concentrate its life insurance business in the public part of the group.
Goldman has a "buy" recommendation also on Pohjola's rival Sampo, but it is "less strong", partly because Sampo trades at a smaller discount compared to its net asset value than Pohjola, Govi said.
He put Pohjola's current net asset value per share at 153 markka and Sampo's NAV at 417 markka.
In October 1996, Govi estimated Pohjola's NAV at 132 markka and Sampo's at 373 markka.
At end-June, Pohjola's NAV was 120 markka and Sampo's NAV 429 markka, according to the companies' own first-half financial statements.
Goldman's 12-month target price for Sampo is 459 markka, Govi said.
At 1225/1025 GMT, Pohjola B traded at 148.50 markka, up 7.00, and Sampo traded at 415.00 markka, up 1.00.
